purpose: Persistent owner design preferences for CallVaal website and app pages. Consult before designing a new page; append decisions instead of silently replacing them.

confirmed.direction: Modern, happy, approachable and India-focused; useful human conversations, not a dating service.

typography.status: Explicit owner selection. Later reference images do not automatically replace this pairing.

layout: Generous breathing room between sections; avoid crowded layouts and too many explanatory sections.
Rounded cards, rounded inputs and pill-shaped controls.
Responsive composition that uses large monitors well without tiny text or enormous empty side margins.
Readable phone layouts and comfortable touch targets; do not merely shrink the desktop page.
brand_character: India-relevant everyday motifs, not religious decoration.
Handwritten notes and white-bordered stickers are liked, but use selectively within the newer cleaner direction.
Real human portraits for people offering conversations.
Professional and everyday support: advice, experience or someone to listen; do not describe everybody as an expert.
avoid: Romantic or dating-site signals, particularly hearts connecting a man and woman.
Christmas-like red-and-green combinations and excessive flowers/leaves.
A predominantly sepia or one-colour page.
Blue as the primary brand colour, unless the owner explicitly revises the earlier restriction.
Clinical guarantees or presenting non-clinical listeners as therapists.

new_reference_direction.status: Owner explicitly likes these references and wants a similar modern feel. The following visual traits are interpretations of the supplied images, not approved final design tokens.
surface_and_colour: Warm off-white/cream surfaces, muted peach, butter yellow, sage/olive and restrained pastel accents.
Dark readable text and clear primary actions; soft shadows and subtle borders rather than heavy outlines.
Limited colour per section with ample neutral space; reference lavender/blue is inspiration, not permission to replace the primary palette.
components: Soft rounded modular cards and grouped panels, especially for future dashboards.
Simple consistent line icons, small circular icon buttons, segmented filters and pill buttons.
Clean typography with an obvious title/body hierarchy, not oversized bubbly display text everywhere.
Selective editorial line-art illustrations; playful 3D characters only where useful, such as onboarding, not all styles mixed together.
Use real portraits and authentic content in profiles; take layout inspiration from the dashboard without copying its employee metrics or HR features.

alternate_type_reference.status: Shown inside a reference image only. Not yet selected instead of Comfortaa/Nunito.

new_reference_direction.scope: Guide future page designs and the next proposed visual refinement. Do not treat reference-image text as product requirements or silently replace the deployed homepage.

references.focus: Rounded pastel cards, light sans typography, line icons and simple mood illustrations.
Cream/sage palette, editorial illustration and quiet visual hierarchy.
Rounded mobile composition, simple navigation and generous spacing.
Reference-only Alegreya/Montserrat pairing and olive/coral/mustard palette.
Minimal rounded forms, segmented controls, clear buttons and selective 3D illustration.
Responsive modular dashboard, restrained yellow accents, portraits and compact line icons.

decision_log.decision: Owner approved the India-sticker homepage and requested more space between sections; that version was deployed and its predecessor archived.
Owner requested improved large-screen responsiveness, then explicitly chose Comfortaa for text and Nunito for titles. These changes are prepared, not yet built or deployed.
Owner supplied six modern UI references and requested persistent preference logging for upcoming pages. Preserve explicit font choices while recording the references as inspiration.

process: Read this file and inspect the relevant reference images before designing additional pages.
Distinguish explicit owner decisions from inferred visual preferences and unselected alternatives.
When a new instruction conflicts with a confirmed preference, record the new decision and its scope.
Do not infer permission to build or deploy from reference uploads or preference logging.
